{{Quote|Torbin, Jedi Padawan…Son of paupers from the planet Bonadan.|Mother Aniseya, to Torbin|<ref name="Choice" />}}
At least two paupers [[Homeworld|from]] the [[planet]] [[Bonadan]] were the '''parents''' of the [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Torbin]],<ref name="Choice" /> who was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[173 BBY]]. Around [[170 BBY]],<ref name="Birth">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' establishes that Torbin was forty-one [[Standard year|years]] old at the [[time]] of the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which occur in [[132 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TheAcolyteDate|here]]. Therefore, he must have been [[Reproduction|born]] around [[173 BBY]]. It also establishes Torbin was given to the [[Jedi Order]] when he was three years old, equating to around [[170 BBY]].</ref> when Torbin was three [[Standard year|years]] old, Torbin's parents gave him to the [[Jedi Order]] after he was identified as having [[The Force|Force]] potential by a [[Unidentified Jedi seeker (Torbin)|Jedi seeker]].<ref name="Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> In [[148 BBY]],<ref name="Brendok Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}} "[[Revenge / Justice]]" establishes that Torbin was stationed on [[Brendok]] sixteen [[Standard year|years]] before its events, equating to [[148 BBY]].</ref> while Torbin—by then a [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]]—was on a [[Mission to Brendok|mission]] to the planet [[Brendok]], the [[witch]] [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]] used a [[Force power|Thread ability]] to make him see a [[Force vision|vision]] of himself alone in the [[Rite of Ascension courtyard|courtyard]] in which he was standing. While he was experiencing the vision, Aniseya spoke to Torbin and mentioned his [[parent]]s.<ref name="Choice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torbin's parents were first mentioned in a vision in "[[Choice]],"<ref name="Choice" /> the seventh episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[July 9]], [[2024]].<ref name="Press">{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=news/next-on-disney-plus-july-2024|text=Next on Disney+: July 2024}}</ref>
